_comment: IC class registry — runners (phase2/aid_class_rtl_gen/etc.) consult this to dispatch deterministic generators per detected IC class. Third-party plugins can append entries to extend coverage.

classes.name: aid_class_half_duplex_single_wire
classes.description: Apple-Lightning-style half-duplex single-wire ID / authentication IC. Host emits BR + opcode (1-byte LSB-first) + optional payload; chip replies with response opcode + payload + CRC8 (poly 0x31 reflected, init 0xFF, residue 0).

classes.name: digital_cmd_driven
classes.description: Generic command-driven digital IC (UART / SPI / I2C / parallel cmd). RTL gen not yet covered by deterministic generator — defer to spec-to-rtl skill.

classes.name: mixed_signal_otp
classes.description: Mixed-signal IC with OTP-driven configuration. Digital control logic + OTP read sequence — partial overlap with aid_class. v1.6.142 (#52) routes through MAIN_FSM_SPEC_COMPLIANT so the dispatcher consumes L3.opcodes (per-opcode case-arms + L3-enumerated silent-reject arms); BASELINE spam-responder produces silent DUT for chips with opcodes outside the AID-convention default reply path.

classes.name: pure_analog
classes.description: Pure analog IC — no digital RTL. Phase 2 SKIPs RTL gen; analog flow (A1..A8) handles via /vibe-ic-analog.

classes.name: bare_fpga
classes.description: FPGA-only design with no silicon target. Phase 2 runs FPGA-side (RTL → SOF), Phase 3 SKIPs.

classes.name: digital_arithmetic_primitive
classes.description: v1.6.522 — for #358 P2. Pure digital data-transform IP (multiplier, adder, filter, hash core, encoder/decoder, arithmetic sub-block). No SW-visible protocol / register map / calibration. Single top module with clock + reset + data ports. L4/L5/L6 legitimately N/A — L2 describes a deterministic combinational/sequential data transform. Phase 2 runner dispatches via fallback_skill=spec-to-rtl since there is no deterministic RTL generator for this open family.

classes.name: processor_cpu
classes.description: v1.6.523 — CPU / processor core / SoC with a memory-bus / data top (instruction-fetch, load/store, register file). No SW-visible half-duplex command protocol on a single-wire bus and no analog content. The AID 3-port (clk/reset_n/id_bus) reference TB cannot bind a memory-bus top, so Phase 2 verification runs the generic full-stack TB driven from L9.top_ports + gate-level synth + Phase 3 instead. RTL gen via fallback_skill / IP-catalog glue (open-source RISC-V / SoC cores).

classes.name: unknown_protocol_class
classes.description: Detection failed or class not yet registered. Runner fall-throughs to fallback_skill — AI takes over via /spec-to-rtl skill.
